about: From Messy Data To Decisions People Trust
Somewhere in your business, someone is rebuilding the same report by hand right now, and still isn’t sure the numbers are right.
I’m a Data Analyst and Automation Specialist with nearly three years of experience across financial services and operations, and that’s the problem I solve.

I clean and validate data at source, analyze it to uncover the patterns behind the numbers, and turn the findings into Power BI dashboards leaders act on. Then I automate the repetitive steps, so the right numbers arrive on time without anyone chasing them.

I’ve cut bottleneck identification from three days to same-day, built a customer database that helped recover 30-40% of dormant customers, and created a data collection system adopted across six departments. Today I prepare recurring regulatory reports in financial services.
I work in SQL, Power BI and Power Query, and I’m certified in AI & Automation, building workflows in n8n and Make. I’m open to remote Data Analyst, BI and Automation Specialist roles.
